|game_text=Deploy on table (only at start of game). You may not deploy Jedi with 'communing' in game text. Your total Force generation is +1 for each Jedi 'communing.' The Cosmic Force: Once per turn, may peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile or Lost Pile, where X = the number of Jedi 'communing'; may move one of those cards to the bottom of that pile.

The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/communing.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/communing.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Communing (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of 22 December 2023; card image marked E1 published 22 December 2023, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/communing.gif</code> as published 22 December 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4c681fe16e36ecdacae201ebbf106b07ffea132b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/communing.gif holotable commit 4c681fe] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/8d3b539101d70f08c5f6e9d812f8b8d4e5a61524 swccg-card-json commit 8d3b539101] (21 December 2023): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game). The Living Force: Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and are considered out of play. Your total Force generation is +1 for each Jedi 'communing.' The Cosmic Force: Once per turn, may peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile or Lost Pile, where X = the number of Jedi 'communing'; may move one of those cards to the bottom of that pile.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 22 December 2023): “Errata added the words 'or search your Used Pile' to the second sentence.” The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. '''What changed:''' “or search your Used Pile” was added to the second sentence (“You may not deploy Jedi with 'communing' in game text or search your Used Pile.”). The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
